entities.name: Saint Anthony Catholic Church, Jaffa
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Anthony of Padua Church or simply Church of St. Anthony, is a religious building of the Catholic church located on Yefet Street in Jaffa, the southwestern district of the city of Tel Aviv in central Israel.
